podcast.title: Reaction to Song
podcast.body: As far as is known, Clint Eastwood has never publicly commented on the Gorillaz song named after him, but he has also never expressed any complaints about it. "As far as anybody knows, Clint Eastwood has never actually commented on the song, but he certainly never complained about it either."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Subject of a Song
podcast.body: The Gorillaz song "Clint Eastwood" is explicitly about the American actor. The song incorporates elements of the theme from his 1966 film "The Good, The Bad, and The Ugly." "The first single from the album was Clint Eastwood. And yes, it's about the American actor."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
